positions.name: MeridianGateMotivation
positions.frame: what drove the Meridian deployment gate into existence?
positions.why: src-1 declares the gate requirement (signed manifests for every Meridian deployment) and src-2 supplies the triggering incident (two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter). Together they answer why the gate exists — the declaration and its proximate cause, both spoken by Quinton Fairweather.

positions.name: MeridianGateScope
positions.frame: what does the Meridian deployment gate require and where does it apply?
positions.why: src-3 states the gate's requirement (signed release manifest) and src-4 states its scope (staging and production). Both are session-level assertions by Xena ExpertGH that together define the gate's operational boundary.
